decision: Expand existing week-view guide with one coherent display-settings diagnostic section; no standalone page for three related settings at this evidence depth.

site:flexibits.com/fantastical-ios/help week numbers first day week alternate calendars
queryLimits: Combined output; no independent per-query rank, volume or ChatGPT citation evidence. Malformed doubled Fantastical path observed in results but NOT fetched; used previously verified canonical instead.

primaryReads.observed: Start Week On, Start Week View On and Show Calendar Weeks are separate settings. Week numbers can use a custom start date.
primaryReads.limits: Publisher feature documentation, not Cloud behavior or ISO conformity. Prior corpus page re-read specifically for new requested settings scope, not counted as newly discovered URL.

primaryReads.observed: Apple Settings > Apps > Calendar distinguishes alternate Chinese/Hebrew/Hijri display alongside Gregorian, Week Numbers, Week View Starts On Today and Start Week On.
primaryReads.limits: Apple Calendar controls, not global guarantee every third-party app follows them. No rule establishing ISO week numbering or date conversion of stored events.

currentCoverage.scope: Complete metadata,6sections each (week13paragraphs/year12),practical,FAQ,sources,related. Targeted ENmodule search for week number/first day/start week/alternate/ISO/Monday/Sunday, not full58body reread.

comparison.already: Checks date range/selection, visible hours, all-day section, overnight shift, edits and external app controls.
comparison.missing: Does not explain why first column can differ across apps, rolling today-based display versus fixed week start, or week-number convention checks.

comparison.already: Year/date interval, marker meanings, recurring exceptions and availability.
comparison.missing: No week-number or alternate-date-label workflow; not necessary to append duplicate settings instructions here.

recommendedAction.type: Substantive existing-guide section after initial date/calendar check, bounded practical check and FAQ if needed
recommendedAction.userTask: Reconcile a calendar whose week starts on a different day or whose week/date labels differ before using it to agree a work week.
contentPlan: Separate first day of week, rolling week beginning today, week-number labels and alternate-calendar labels.
Give Apple route explicitly as Apple Calendar, and Fantastical custom-week numbering as a reason not to assume two labels mean identical date ranges.
For a plan called week12, communicate actual start/end dates and year; compare date headers near year boundary instead of moving events to fix display.
Alternate-calendar display is not the same as adding another account or importing a holiday calendar; use Apple documented alongside-Gregorian scope and verify actual event date.
recommendedAction.nativeGate: Before naming any Cloud setting or promising Apple settings carry through, inspect current immutable native commit for firstWeekday/weekOfYear/alternate-calendar settings and consumers. This research did not inspect native code.
avoid: No ISO8601 rule unless separately sourced.
No Cloud Chinese/Hebrew/Hijri or custom-week support inference.
No claim view changes reschedule events, synchronize settings across apps or grant access.
No separate synonym pages for Monday-start/weeknumbers/alternative dates based on this alone.

failuresAndLimits: All selected actual primary pages accessible. Combined output truncation affected navigation portion; substantive Apple1136–1203 and Fantastical61–150 were visible and read.
Actual settings topics establish utility, not demand size or ranking potential.
